groups.label: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.
groups.printed: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Beacon of Faith
choices.text: A warlord with this trait gains the Acts of Faith & Faith (1) special rule (see Army rules). If the unit already has the Faith (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

choices.name: Impervious to Pain
choices.text: The Warlord gains the Feel no Pain (5+) and Battle-Hardened special rule.

choices.name: Inspiring Orator
choices.text: All friendly units within 24" of a model with this Warlord trait may use the Warlord Leadership (LD) characteristic instead of their own.

groups.label: All Imperium Adeptus Sororitas or Cult Ministorum Priests with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:
groups.printed: All Imperium Adeptus Sororitas or Cult Ministorum Priests with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:

choices.name: Litany of Blazing Piety
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, target 1 enemy model within 12" of the Priest. The target model takes D3+3, Strength 6, AP5 automatic hits.

choices.name: Litany of Enduring Faith
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Focus
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit has the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Fury
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gains the Fleet special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Hatred
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Holy Piety
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, gain 1 Faith Point and add it to your pool of Faith.
